title: Server setup
welcome:
Hi! Let's get **{server}** ready. I'll ask you {total} quick questions: your rules channel, your welcome channel, a role for new members and a log channel.

It takes about a minute, you can skip any question, and everything you pick is saved right away.

rules.title: Where are your rules?
rules.text: Pick the channel where your server rules are. New members will get a button that takes them there.

welcome.title: Where should I welcome people?
welcome.text: Pick the channel for welcome messages. I'll greet new members there.

member.title: Which role do new members get?
member.text: Pick the role I should give to new members automatically. Choose a plain member role, not one with moderator or admin powers.

log.title: Where should I post logs?
log.text: Pick the channel for security reports and logs. A private channel for your team works best.

roleManaged: I can't give that role: it's managed by an integration, or it's @everyone. Pick another one.
roleAbove: I can't give **{role}** because it's above my own role. Move my role above it in Server Settings → Roles, or pick another role.
roleDangerous: **{role}** has powerful permissions ({perms}), so every new member would get them. Pick a plain member role instead.
postcheckHint: Run /postcheck in that channel for the exact steps.
next: You can change any of this later with /serversettings, add more channels with /channels set, and open the full control panel with /dashboard.
prefixLine: Your prefix is `{prefix}`, so commands also work as `{prefix}help`.
cancelled: Setup cancelled. Nothing else was changed.
cancelledSaved: Setup cancelled. What you already picked is saved.
timeout: This setup timed out. Run /setup again whenever you're ready.
timeoutSaved: This setup timed out. What you already picked is saved: run /setup again to continue.
needAdmin: You need the Administrator permission to run the setup.
guildOnly: Setup only works inside a server.
notYours: This setup was started by someone else. Run /setup to start your own.
error: Something went wrong. Please try /setup again.
